detail.sDescription: At range, the Harbinger can deliver accurate, powerful rounds that are great for sniping exposed targets. When confonted up close it can be fanned quickly at the cost of accuracy, perfect for taking down wounded targets or forcing enemies to step back from the flurry of shots.

eAmmoCategory.sDescription: Large-bore cartridges originally designed for revolvers, but usable in all .44 caliber firearms.
